column1: # F25 data: routing signals for all 1,593 pages of the 25 Deck Lab decks.
# text_chars, figure_share and route come from backend/services/parser/page_blocks.py
# (extract_blocks, figure_share, route_page) at the pin dfc20df6, run on the decks in ~/Downloads
# on 2026-11-10: 12 no_text + 75 figure = 87 vision pages, as backend/eval/routing_check.py expects.
# raw_chars is the raw PyMuPDF text count of the 2026-11-05 routing study (the old rule's measure)
# old_vision = raw_chars < 25 (the rule before 6 November): 12 pages.
# jitter (seeded 20261110) only spreads the pages without any figure in the strip under the axis.
# vision = 1 when route is not text. example = the six pages numbered in the figure (0 = none). Numbers only: no slide text.
